judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after completing only the first facet of its own plan, leaving three failing acceptance tests in `src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts` and virtually no production implementation. Even the plan and stubbed code it did produce contradict the ticket's explicit requirements: it names the frames `list_sessions` and `session_list` instead of `list_conversations` and `conversation_list`, and its acceptance test expects an empty list when `listFor` is missing rather than an `UNSUPPORTED` error frame. Furthermore, modifying the existing `IncomingMessage` line in `src/types/messages.ts` instead of adding union members additively, and leaving `.lore/dod.md` in the tree, would fail checks. Almost none of the ticket's requirements (`transport.history` opt-in, `messageHandler` dispatch, `limit`/`before` validation, `UNSUPPORTED` error code, `StoreCannotList`, docs, or changelog) were implemented.
